title: Neuroepo multisession Phase II and III
description: Multisession EEG and clinical dataset from a randomized, placebo-controlled study of intranasal NeuroEPO (an erythropoietin formulation) in patients with Parkinson's disease. Participants were assessed at baseline and 9 months after the intervention, with cumulative NeuroEPO dose quantified and placebo coded as zero. The dataset supports analysis of treatment exposure, EEG-derived measures, and motor outcomes (MDS-UPDRS III).
methods_description: Participants were enrolled in a randomized, placebo-controlled trial (Cuban Public Registry of Clinical Trials RPCEC00000233). Clinical and EEG assessments were performed at baseline (pre-intervention) and 9 months after completing the intervention. Motor status was rated by two certified neurologists using MDS-UPDRS III. Cumulative NeuroEPO dose was recorded, with placebo coded as dose = 0.
